key_events: Rhea's transaction triggered an automated Audit Flag.
Vex materialized to audit her exploit, threatening an administrative ban.
Rhea countered by pointing out that logging the ban would expose Ashwood's UI logic flaw to higher-ups.
Artie emerged from the brush, suffering from severe System-induced damage after failing to pay gathering taxes.
Artie demanded to know how Rhea bypassed the stamina drain.
Rhea was cornered at the deposit node.
Vex threatened Rhea with an administrative ban for her exploit, while Artie demanded to know her secret to avoid bleeding out.
Rhea realized she couldn't fight them both and proposed a joint venture to solve all their problems.
Rhea projected a party formation window, offering Vex a way to balance the ledger and Artie a way to survive.
Both Vex and Artie accepted the terms, formally binding the three of them into a System party and dismissing the immediate audit threat.
The party accepted the Vermin Control quest.
Rhea stowed her Copper Credits to prepare for combat.
Artie successfully drew aggro from the scavengers in the collapsed transit tunnel.
Rhea moved into position to execute the physics exploit with her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon.
Rhea used her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon to collapse the tunnel ceiling on the scavengers.
Artie survived the encounter, maintaining his fragile 4 HP.
The system awarded untaxed loot and completed the Vermin Control quest without deducting durability or stamina.
Rhea gathered the Scavenger Carapaces and Copper Credits.
The System officially formed the party 'The Mercy Cache (Provisional)'.
The Mutual Assured Destruction status effect was applied to all members.
Rhea confirmed her 11 Copper Credits and Vance his 5 Copper Credits.
Rhea readied her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon and Vance his Rebar as they prepared to move on.
Vance Harrow signed the Custom Liability Contract.
Unit 734 signed the Custom Liability Contract.
The System officially formed the party and applied the Mutual Assured Destruction buff to all members.
Rhea stowed her Copper Credits in her right blazer pocket.
